_comment: Current ratings for the feeder's line codes. The published package supplies R, X and C only, with no ampacity anywhere, so these are added here rather than taken from the data. See notes/importer_open_items.md item 1.
_status: PROVISIONAL. The conductor sizes are established (see _evidence). The ampere values are typical ratings for those sizes and still need confirming against AS/NZS 3008.1.1 before results are reported. Munir to check Tables 4 and 5 for the relevant installation method.
_naming: Line code names carry the conductor size two ways. Decimal names are legacy imperial copper in square inches: 2c_.007 is 0.007 sq.in = 4.5 mm2. Whole-number names are nominal mm2, aluminium for the larger sizes. Both readings are confirmed by the published resistance.
_evidence: Conductor area back-calculated from R1 at 20 C, against the size in the name. Copper resistivity 17.2 ohm.mm2/km, aluminium 28.2.
_installation_assumption: Direct buried, 4-core or 2-core XLPE, 25 C soil, grouping factor 1.0. A different installation method changes every rating, so it is recorded here as one decision rather than per cable.

transformer_thermal._comment: IEC 60076-7 exponential model. Values are the standard's typical set for distribution transformers, Table 4.
transformer_thermal._status: PROVISIONAL, confirm against IEC 60076-7 Table 4 and a datasheet for a unit of this rating.
